name: OnePlus 13
notes: PJZ110 = China (ColorOS), CPH2653 = EU, CPH2655 = NA, CPH2649 = India (to confirm). OTA codename OP5D0DL1 (seen in the PJZ110 17.0.0.103 OTA); recovery board dodge. Network/region files are oplusstanvbk (physical) and my_region (logical, inside super). From ColorOS 16.0.3.501 the bootloader has a hardware anti-rollback fuse: installing an older build bricks the phone beyond EDL repair (reported Jan 2026 for OnePlus 13, 13T, 15).

known_issues.message: ColorOS 17 CN: on the release candidate, 'adb reboot fastboot' left phones stuck (fastbootd crash, bootloader fastboot reboot loop, EDL reflash needed). Do not reboot to fastboot or the bootloader on this build until a fix is confirmed. Use the official rollback to ColorOS 16 instead.
